name: SearchField
summary: Specialized Input variant for search. Leading Search icon, trailing Clear button (visible when value is non-empty), submit-on-Enter, optional suggestions popover. Two flavors — inline (small chrome, sits in a toolbar) and prominent (large chrome, sits at the top of a search page).

variant.description: command: ⌘K-style command-palette trigger button (not an input itself; opens the palette).

loading.description: Replaces the leading icon with a Spinner during async search.

suggestions.description: Render-prop slot for an inline / portaled suggestions Popover.

kbdHint.description: Render an inline Kbd at the trailing edge ('⌘K').

keyboard: Escape - clear when value is non-empty / blur when empty
ArrowDown - move focus to the first suggestion (when popover is open)
rules: Wrap in <form role='search'>; the <input type='search'> announces 'search' to SR.
When suggestions popover is open, the input adopts aria-autocomplete='list' + aria-controls={listboxId}.
Each suggestion has role='option' and announces aria-selected when focused.

do: Use inline variant in toolbars, navbars, settings.
Use prominent variant at the top of search pages.
Use command variant as the ⌘K trigger — it opens the CommandPalette, not the inline suggestions.
Pair with kbdHint='⌘K' to teach the shortcut.
dont: Don't use SearchField for non-search inputs.
Don't render the Clear button as danger red — it's a utility action.
Don't auto-submit on every keystroke — debounce or wait for Enter.
